title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts and the Manufacturer's Warranty
content:
Holding a manufacturer warranty coverage changes what a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract pays.

**Factory coverage pays first.** A failure covered at the repair date and odometer by an in-force manufacturer warranty coverage, or by an open recall in the warranty records, is paid by that coverage, not by the service contract.

**What the contract pays.** The service contract pays only for components, or for date and mileage, that the factory coverage does not reach. A line that the factory coverage pays is never also paid by the contract.

**Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap.** A Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap contract and the factory powertrain warranty run side by side. For a powertrain failure inside the factory powertrain coverage, the factory warranty pays and the wrap pays nothing.

| Failure at the repair date and odometer (hypothetical) | Paid by |
|---|---|
| Inside an in-force manufacturer coverage for that component | the manufacturer coverage; the contract pays nothing for that line |
| Subject of an open recall in the warranty records | the recall; the contract pays nothing for that line |
| Component outside every in-force factory coverage | the service contract, under its own terms |
| Factory coverage expired by date or mileage | the service contract, under its own terms |
